description: Per-lane gain then offset: value_k=sat_u8((((a_k*b_k)+128)>>8)+c_k) where b_k is a Q8 gain and c_k an unsigned offset. aux[3:0]=lanes clamped at 255. fault=any clamp.
hardware_advantage: Scale-and-bias on 4 channels per beat for white balance or dither-free gamma: the multiply, rounding shift and bias are one hardwired cone.
